meta.source: inputs/reference.mp4 (30 s 2026 big-game travel-app spot, toy-miniature world)
meta.note: bin/dissect found 13 shots; two missed cuts (7.92 phone POV -> tower wide, 15.17 under the cloud wipe) are split here, so 15 source shots.

acts.name: Hook: the same old beach
acts.function: premise in VO, the dream (plane through binoculars), the hero's wish 'I need an adventure.'

acts.name: The app
acts.function: he books on the phone, asks the sky about booking a flight now and a stay later, the narrator answers with the product claim; packing, flying

acts.name: Trip montage
acts.function: three vignettes (tea room, pastel street, horse on a plain) under 'the more he travels, the more he saves'

acts.name: Payoff: the free rental
acts.function: rewards screen, 'In {HERO} math, it was free.', wrong side of the road gag

acts.name: End card
acts.function: aerial, logo, spoken and written tagline

look.world: Everything is a real toy miniature: 1:6 scale articulated vinyl dolls with sculpted hair and mouths that never move, handmade dioramas, fabric clothes, cotton-wool clouds, plastic props. Photographed like a premium stop-motion film: real lens, real light, shallow depth of field on closes.
look.grade: warm, pastel, golden-hour peach and pink skies, cyan sky blues, the {BRAND_COLOUR} (default tangerine #F58220) repeated on every branded prop (phone case, suitcase, plane, car, parasols)
look.contrast: soft, lifted blacks, no crushed shadows
look.light: soft sun, mostly low and warm; interiors warm practicals
look.depth_of_field: shallow on closes (phone, binoculars, mount), deep on wides
look.brightness: bright exteriors 125-175 (beach 135, tower wide 174, phone POV 153-164), interiors and dusk 77-110 (plane 103-109, tea room 94-100, street 88, car mount 77, road 98-127); end card 101 -> 148

text_style.bug: white geometric-sans wordmark with the round mark, top-left x 3-19% / y 5-10%, on from frame 1 until the end card
text_style.legal: small white geometric sans medium, 15 px at 720p, centred at y 95%, cut with its shot
text_style.end_card: white: mark + wordmark, then a two-line tagline in tall condensed bold caps with one handwritten script word on each line; written on left to right; a {BRAND_COLOUR} border with rounded inner corners
text_style.case: caps for the tagline, sentence case elsewhere

sound.music: One upbeat instrumental bed at 136 bpm (beat 0.441 s, bar 1.765 s, bars at 1.126 + n x 1.765) under the whole film, entering at 1.1 s after 1 s of surf and gulls, steady at about -15 to -25 dB under the voices, a final hit and ring-out at the end card. set/score.wav is the film's soundtrack with the voices removed (vocal/music separation).
sound.speech: Two voices. The narrator: a warm, wry, mid-pitch male documentary-style voice-over, measured and deadpan, about 3 words per second. The hero: a bright, earnest, slightly over-sincere male voice, delivered by a doll whose mouth never moves. They alternate line by line, almost without gaps; the narrator talks to the hero like a 'voice in the sky'.
sound.mix: voices on top at about -14 dB RMS, music 6-10 dB under, small stop-motion foley (pops, whooshes, propeller, engine)

char_hero.fixes: The hero, an invented articulated vinyl fashion doll of a man in his forties: deep warm brown satin-vinyl skin, glossy sculpted jet-black pompadour with a sharp left part and a silver streak at the right temple, pencil moustache, groomed brows, amber eyes, fixed closed-mouth half-smile, dimpled chin, ball joints. Plastic-perfect and overly groomed. Wardrobe sheet: (1) mint-striped camp shirt + white jeans (beach), (2) terracotta tile-print shirt + coral neck pillow (plane), (3) indigo robe jacket over tangerine tee (tea room), (4) cream linen shirt + crossbody bag (street), (5) sky-blue shirt + tangerine silk scarf (horse, car).

char_passengers.fixes: Two background passenger dolls for shot 7, cropped at the frame edges: grey-bob woman in sage cardigan and tortoiseshell glasses; ginger-bearded man in oatmeal sweater with navy headphones.

product_phone.fixes: Toy phone in a glossy tangerine (#F58220) rubber case, black bezel, blank white screen for compositing.

product_suitcase.fixes: Tangerine ribbed hard-shell carry-on, silver telescopic handle, black spinner wheels, white {BRAND_MARK} + {BRAND} on the front; plus the top-down open packed view for shot 6.

product_car.fixes: Tangerine vintage two-seat roadster, top down, chrome round headlights and grille, cream whitewall tyres, tan leather seats, dashboard phone mount; the suitcase rides in the passenger seat.

product_plane.fixes: Toy high-wing prop plane: white fuselage, tangerine wings, struts and tail, the round mark on the tail, navy cheat line, black propeller (shot 2).

prop_horse.fixes: Chestnut toy horse with dark mane, white socks, brown bridle (shot 10).

prop_binoculars.fixes: Small black toy binoculars with a brown strap (shot 3).

loc_beach.fixes: Sunset miniature beach: grey-white lifeguard tower with ramp and ring buoy, tangerine parasols and loungers, peach sand, dark rocks, calm sea, headland right, pink cotton clouds. Brightness about 135.

loc_tower_sky.fixes: The same tower from below against a pastel cyan-to-peach sky with small pink clouds and distant palms (shots 3, 5). Brightness 140-175.

loc_sky_clouds.fixes: Pastel sky with pink-lit cotton-wool clouds: shot 2's background and the cloud-wipe element (shots 7-8).

loc_packing_rug.fixes: Pale powder-blue rug with fine woven vertical stripes, top-down (shot 6). Brightness about 135.

loc_plane_cabin.fixes: Miniature cabin: teal plastic seats, grey seatback screens with a flight-map line, oval windows with pink clouds, warm beige walls (shot 7).

loc_ryokan.fixes: Tatami tea room: dark wood, paper screens, open window on a snow-capped volcano and pink blossom, low lacquered table with teapot, navy cushions, paper lantern (shot 8). Brightness about 95-100.

loc_colour_street.fixes: Colonial street of yellow, teal, red and blue facades, turquoise-trim arches, iron balconies, cut-paper bunting, black lamps (shot 9). Brightness about 88.

loc_mountain_plain.fixes: Golden grass plain, adobe farm buildings, jagged snow-dusted range (shot 10). Brightness about 133.

loc_vineyard_road.fixes: Country road through rolling vineyard hills with cypresses and red-roofed farmhouses, golden-hour haze (shots 11-14).

loc_hills_aerial.fixes: Aerial of the same hills with a winding road, the end card's picture (shot 15).

ui.fixes: Every screen, logo and super, flat and full-size with exact copy (invented brand 'Voyalo', tangerine #F58220 / navy #1D2B4F). Timings and placements in set/ui.json.

lines.fixes: The film's 15 recorded lines (voice stem), with brand, hero-name and tagline words muted to silence; word times in lines.json.

voice_narrator.fixes: The narrator's timbre: 10.1 s of L01, L06, L09, L11 (no brand words).

voice_hero.fixes: The hero's timbre: 7.1 s of L02, L05, L07, L10, L14 (all he says apart from L12).

score.fixes: The soundtrack minus the voices, and its 30 s / 15 s cuts.

HERO.where: spoken in L03 (4.70-4.95), L08 (15.46-15.71), L12 (22.80-23.05, by the hero himself), L13 (24.16-24.52); written 'Hi, {HERO}' on ui_rewards

cut30.arc: Hook (0-5.21): an empty sunset beach, 'When every day feels the same, one man wants more.', a plane seen through binoculars, the plastic-perfect hero lowers them: 'I need an adventure.' Middle (5.21-20.54): the app (hotel list scroll), his question shouted at the sky, stop-motion packing, the narrator answering ('Book now or add later. You still save.'), 'Thanks, voice in the sky.', a cloud wipe into a tea room, a pastel street, 'Good horsey.' Payoff (20.54-27.25): rewards screen, 'In {HERO} math, it was free.', driving on the wrong side, 'Oh, mi scusi.' End card (27.25-30.0): aerial, logo, '{BRAND}. {TAGLINE}'.
